description: This file defines a custom Lexical node for embedding YouTube videos, including component rendering, serialization, deserialization, and related methods for managing YouTube nodes within a Lexical editor.

classes.name: YouTubeNode
classes.description: A Lexical DecoratorBlockNode subclass representing a YouTube video embed, with methods for serialization, DOM export/import, and rendering.

methods.name: convertYoutubeElement
methods.description: Converts an HTML iframe element with YouTube data into a DOMConversionOutput for Lexical.

methods.name: $createYouTubeNode
methods.description: Factory function to create a new YouTubeNode instance with specified videoID.

methods.name: $isYouTubeNode
methods.description: Type guard to check if a node is a YouTubeNode.
